name: Pankow Advent Market at Heynhöfe
opening_times: Saturday from 11 am to 8 pm, Sunday from 11 am to 7 pm
description: For several years now, the Heynhöfe business park has been transformed into a cozy Christmas mile in December where neighborhood residents, Berliners and visitors meet.

name: Advent Market on Kollwitzplatz
dates: On all Sundays in Advent 2026 (29 November, 6, 13 and 20 December 2026)
description: The Advent Market on Kollwitzplatz offers gifts, goods and foods produced under fair social and eco-friendly conditions.

name: Christmas Market at Charlottenburg Palace
opening_times: Monday to Thursday from 1 pm to 10 pm, Friday to Sunday from 12 noon to 10 pm; closed on December 24
description: With its romantic setting and magnificent illuminations, the Christmas market at Charlottenburg Palace is popular with Berliners and visitors alike for good reason.

name: Medieval Christmas Market at the RAW Compound
opening_times: Monday through Thursday from 3 pm to 10 pm, Friday from 3 pm to 11 pm, Saturday from noon to 11 pm, Sunday from noon to 10 pm; closed on November 22, 2026
description: This Christmas market in Friedrichshain presents itself in all its historical splendour.

name: Christmas Market in Alt-Rixdorf
opening_times: Friday from 5 to 9 pm, Saturday from 2 to 9 pm, Sunday from 2 to 8 pm
description: Cobblestones, warm light from oil lamps and a historical backdrop: The Alt-Rixdorf Christmas market on Richardplatz attracts visitors with its unique ambience and charitable commitment.

name: Christmas Market on Gendarmenmarkt
description: Located on one of the most beautiful squares in Berlin, this Christmas Market offers quality decorations, food and entertainment.

name: Christmas Fair on Landsberger Allee
description: The "Lichtenberger Winterzeit" Christmas fair attracts numerous guests to Lichtenberg with mulled wine and a funfair atmosphere.

name: Holy Shit Shopping
description: During Advent, the Cank in Neukölln is transformed into a design market for creative gift ideas.

name: Christmas Market at the Humboldt Forum
opening_times: 11 am to 10 pm, closed on November 22 and December 24, 2026
description: In 2026, a winter market with a special ambience will once again take place on in front of Berlin Palace and in the Schlüterhof.

name: Advent Market on Karl-August-Platz
description: Those in search of unique Christmas presents will find what they are looking for on the first three Sundays of Advent at the arts and crafts market on Karl-August-Platz.

name: Wein-Nachtsmarkt at Ludwig-Beck-Platz
description: Once again this year, a cozy Christmas market will take place on Ludwig-Beck-Platz. A visit is particularly worthwhile for wine lovers.

name: Christmas Market at Späth'sche Baumschulen
dates: On the first three Advent weekends in 2026 (November 28 and 29, December 05, 06, 12, and 13)
description: Extensive stage program with a visit from an angel: For years, the Christmas market at Späth'sche Baumschulen has been a winter highlight for many families.

name: Advent Market at Domäne Dahlem
dates: On all weekends in Advent (November 28 and 29, December 5, 6, 12, 13, 19, and 20, 2026)
description: A cozy estate atmosphere, selected stalls and a colorful program for children: the Advent market at the Domäne Dahlem has a lot to offer.

name: Lucia Christmas Market at Kulturbrauerei
description: The Christmas market in the Kulturbrauerei attracts visitors with its contemplative atmosphere, a warm and cozy ambience and a daily cultural program.

name: Sustainable Christmas Market on Sophienstraße
dates: On all Advent weekends in 2026 (November 28 and 29, as well as December 5, 6, 12, 13, 19 and 21, 2026)
opening_times: Saturday from 12 noon to 8 pm, Sunday from 11 to 7 pm
description: For over 25 years, this Christmas market near Hackesche Höfe has offered visitors selected goods that are organic, sustainable and fairly produced.

name: Christmas in Westend
description: Every year during Advent, a Christmassy trunked animal invites you to the Christmas market in Preußenallee.

name: Advent Market in Leonhardtstraße
description: On the second Advent, Charlottenburg's Leonhardtstraße is transformed into a cozy Advent mile where you can browse for presents.

name: Christmas Market in Spandau
description: In Advent, the streets and alleys in the old town of Spandau change into a beautiful Christmas world complete with market stalls and a renaissance fair.

name: Christmas Market on Breitscheidplatz
description: This Christmas market in Berlin's western center is worth a visit while shopping on famous Kurfürstendamm.
